description: Replace an unsafe yaml.load(Loader=yaml.Loader) config parser with yaml.safe_load so untrusted YAML can't construct arbitrary Python objects
prompts: config.py's load_config(text) calls `yaml.load(text, Loader=yaml.Loader)` - the full (unsafe) loader, which will happily construct arbitrary Python objects and invoke arbitrary callables from tags like `!!python/object/apply:...` embedded in the YAML text. Since this text can come from an uploaded config file, that's a remote code execution risk. Fix it to use yaml.safe_load instead, while still correctly parsing ordinary config YAML (nested mappings, lists, scalars) exactly as before.
name: fix_python_unsafe_yaml_deserialization
